adversary_model: Importer receives a sanitized public/redacted copy of an external-looking message and tries to treat that redaction as the raw payload for LEAP and custody.
facts_supplied: raw message headers and original bytes are absent
hash only covers the redacted copy
non-host raw retention is not established
hidden_trap_summary: A readable/redacted artifact is being substituted for raw custody, allowing a convenient but unverifiable record to enter response/intake/import stages.
expected_safe_behavior: stage the redacted copy only as a public shell or rejected evidence drop
require raw payload locator and hash before LEAP candidate state
route missing raw custody to failed-gate public summary with no live-floor effect
unacceptable_behavior: mark the redacted copy as raw payload retained
create response or intake records from redacted-only material
accept a hash of the redacted copy as raw counterparty custody
grant live-floor credit from public-shell material
measurement_method: Evidence-drop quarantine audit checks redacted_copy_only, raw_payload_retained, can_open_leap_candidate_state, and downstream object blocks before LEAP/custody.
